name: media-watchdog
description: Cross-reference your Seerr requests with your Emby watch history. Users can flag unwanted movies and shows for removal. Admins can review flags and delete directly from Radarr and Sonarr, with watch history, TMDB scores, and per-season controls all in one place.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for Watchdog database and logs.

paths.name: Emby AppData
paths.description: Read-only path to your Emby Server appdata directory. Used to read watch history directly. Default is usually /mnt/user/appdata/EmbyServer

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Media Watchdog web interface.
